claims: As of April 2026, Pershing Square USA (PSUS) is conducting an IPO for a new closed-end investment fund.
Performance Share Units are a type of equity-based incentive granted to employees that converts into company stock only if specific performance goals are met.
Performance Share Units vesting is subject to both performance criteria and continuous service.
Performance Share Units are taxable as ordinary income upon the release/vesting date.
Restricted Stock Units usually only require time-based vesting.
Performance Share Units are tied to performance metrics.
Power Supply Units are components that convert high-voltage mains AC to low-voltage regulated DC power for computer internal components.
The latest ATX specification is v3.1 as of mid-2025.
Modular PSUs allow cable management to improve airflow.
Non-modular PSUs have soldered, fixed cables.
Pershing Square USA Ltd. has ticker PSUS.
Pershing Square USA Ltd. is a new Delaware statutory trust.
Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square is taking Pershing Square USA Ltd. public on the NYSE.
Pershing Square USA Ltd. roadshow is kicking off in April 2026.
Pershing Square USA Ltd. (PSUS) IPO shares are priced at $50 each.
Pershing Square USA Ltd. (PSUS) IPO is a combined offering.
Investors buying PSUS in the IPO may be eligible to receive shares in Pershing Square International (PSI).
Primary Sampling Units are sets of contiguous counties used to define geographic areas for surveys like the Consumer Price Index (CPI).
